sources.locator: Title search: PQ/T 混合方案术语

statement.zh: **协议**：PQ/T 混合方案术语（Terminology for Post-Quantum Traditional Hybrid Schemes）。可引用的权威文本是术语文件 RFC 9794，它把混合方案讲清楚：§4「PQ/T hybrid protocol: A protocol that uses two or more component algorithms providing the same cryptographic functionality, where at least one is a post-quantum algorithm and at least one is a traditional algorithm.」同节还给出复合式定义——字段与消息流与单算法版本相同的形态。
statement.en: **Protocol**: Terminology for Post-Quantum Traditional Hybrid Schemes (PQ/T 混合方案术语).The citable authority here is the terminology document RFC 9794, which defines the hybrid construction: §4 "PQ/T hybrid protocol: A protocol that uses two or more component algorithms providing the same cryptographic functionality, where at least one is a post-quantum algorithm and at least one is a traditional algorithm." the same section defines the composite form whose fields and message flow match a single-algorithm version.

statement.zh: 混合的理由是后量子算法本身也可能被攻破：§2「it should not be assumed that an algorithm will not be compromised just because it is designed to provide post-quantum cryptography.」§1 记录先取后藏的威胁：「Data encrypted today (in 2025) with an algorithm vulnerable to a quantum computer can be stored for decryption by a future attacker with a CRQC.」§5 给出混合属性的定义式表述：只要有一个提供该功能的组件算法仍然安全，性质就成立。
statement.en: Hybridisation is justified because post-quantum algorithms can break too: §2 warns "it should not be assumed that an algorithm will not be compromised just because it is designed to provide post-quantum cryptography." §1 records the harvest-now threat: "Data encrypted today (in 2025) with an algorithm vulnerable to a quantum computer can be stored for decryption by a future attacker with a CRQC." §5 defines the hybrid property: it holds as long as at least one component algorithm providing that function remains secure.

statement.zh: 术语用于区分两种落地路径：§4 用「PQ/T hybrid protocol with composite key establishment」描述在协议字段与消息流不变的前提下引入混合 KEM，用 composite data authentication 描述把 PQ 与 traditional 签名一起呈现为单一接口的做法。§5 则给出选型提示：为互通而做的混合必须满足混合互通性，而为实现安全而做的混合「will likely require」混合机密性或混合认证——原文保留概率措辞。同节还强调「It is not possible for one PQ/T hybrid scheme or PQ/T hybrid protocol to achieve all of the properties in this section.」。
statement.en: The vocabulary separates two deployment paths: §4 uses "PQ/T hybrid protocol with composite key establishment" for a hybrid KEM that leaves protocol fields and message flow unchanged, and the composite-data-authentication form for exposing PQ and traditional signatures through a single interface.§5 gives selection advice: hybrid interoperability for interworking, implementation-security schemes “will likely require” hybrid confidentiality or authentication, and the document warns "It is not possible for one PQ/T hybrid scheme or PQ/T hybrid protocol to achieve all of the properties in this section."。.

statement.zh: 限制集中在两点。第一，同时提供机密性与认证的协议未必两种混合性质都有：§5 说「PQ/T hybrid protocols that offer both confidentiality and authentication do not necessarily offer both hybrid confidentiality and hybrid authentication.」并举例基于 RFC 5280 单算法证书时只有单算法认证。第二，混合证书不是必然给出混合身份认证：§6「The use of a PQ/T hybrid certificate does not necessarily achieve hybrid authentication of the identity of the sender; this is determined by properties of the chain of trust.」。
statement.en: Two limits.A protocol offering both services need not provide both hybrid properties: §5 states "PQ/T hybrid protocols that offer both confidentiality and authentication do not necessarily offer both hybrid confidentiality and hybrid authentication." giving the single-algorithm X.509 certificate example.
